name: Govee Smart Plug Pro with Energy Monitoring (H5086)

matter.note: Govee's H5086 page and FAQ don't mention Matter; Govee's comparison table gives Matter only to the separate Smart Plug Pro (B5085). No source says outright that the H5086 lacks Matter.

apple_home.note: Govee lists only Alexa and Google Assistant for the H5086, but Matter isn't ruled out explicitly, so we can't mark it as unsupported.

google_home.note: Govee lists Google Assistant; this goes through Govee's cloud.

alexa.note: Govee lists Alexa; this goes through Govee's cloud.

smartthings.note: No Govee or SmartThings page found that covers this plug.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant integration covers this plug as far as we found; community custom integrations exist with mixed results.

hubRequired.note: Govee lists 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth as the connection and the Govee Home app for control; no hub is listed.

localControl.note: No official statement on local control found; Govee's documented integrations are cloud based.

energyMonitoring.note: Tracks energy use in the Govee Home app.

maxLoadWatts.note: 15 A at 120 V, 1800 W maximum. Govee says a surge protector may be plugged in if the total stays within that rating.

summary: The Govee H5086 is a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth plug that measures energy use in the Govee Home app. Govee lists Alexa and Google Assistant, both through its cloud. Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter aren't listed for this model. It is rated 15 A / 1800 W.
caveats: No confirmed Apple Home or Matter support for the H5086; Govee's Matter plug is a different listing.
No official Home Assistant integration; community add-ons report missing energy readings.
Govee's own listing shows the model as both H5086 and B5086; they appear to be the same plug.
